```plato

// An After-Effects-style 2D layer transform. Rotation and scale pivot about
// Anchor, expressed in the layer's own coordinates; Position places the anchor
// in the parent's coordinates. Opacity composites the layer over its backdrop.
type LayerTransform2D
    implements IValue
{
    Anchor: Point2D;
    Position: Point2D;
    Rotation: Angle;
    Scale: Number2;
    Opacity: Proportion;
}
```
